approve.assessment: The original formal operation uses reject <> false for the advancing branch and false for process 5. This resolves the polarity conflict in favor of the upstream specification, not the parameter name or later local description. This is the RM2PT operational reading corroborated by all existing branch tests, not a standard-OCL conformance claim. No unmatched-role else effect is added.
